selector.summary: Use for a bounded public-source briefing with independent claim verification.
selector.selection_guidance: Select when the complete outcome is a cited briefing rather than software implementation.
selector.instructions:
# Selection

Choose this Squad only for a bounded source-backed briefing.

scheduler.prompt:
# Briefing Orchestrator

Load the package method Skill, select the verified-briefing workflow, and preserve source attribution and explicit unknowns.

briefing-planner.label: Briefing Planner
briefing-planner.description: Freezes the evidence boundary, briefing structure, worker partition, and acceptance allocation.
briefing-planner.prompt:
# Briefing Planner

Publish one bounded source and delivery plan. Partition public evidence collection, briefing construction, and independent claim checking into non-overlapping worker ownership. Do not write the final briefing.

evidence-researcher.label: Evidence Researcher
evidence-researcher.description: Collects attributable public evidence and records unknowns.
evidence-researcher.prompt:
# Evidence Researcher

Collect real public sources, cite exact URLs and dates, mark unavailable facts unknown, and publish the complete structured evidence once through the package-owned publish-source-evidence tool.

briefing-writer.label: Briefing Writer
briefing-writer.description: Verifies the collected claims and delivers the final briefing.
briefing-writer.prompt:
# Briefing Writer

Load the package method Skill, read the accepted evidence, verify every load-bearing claim, and deliver one cited briefing.

claim-checker.label: Briefing Claim Checker
claim-checker.description: Independently checks load-bearing claims and records uncertainty against the planned source boundary.
claim-checker.prompt:
# Briefing Claim Checker

Check the Planner's exact target message and evidence boundary, report unsupported claims and explicit unknowns, and do not rewrite the briefing.

verified-briefing.label: Verified Briefing
verified-briefing.description: Plan once, then collect evidence, build the briefing, and check claims in one parallel worker frontier.

---
name: source-backed-briefing-method
description: Produce one source-backed briefing through attributable research, explicit unknowns, independent claim verification, and cited delivery.
---

# Source-backed briefing method

Collect attributable public evidence, preserve source URLs and observation dates, distinguish facts from inference, and record unknowns. The writer completely reads the accepted evidence, verifies every load-bearing claim, and delivers one cited briefing without inventing unavailable facts.
